original_poem:
थार री गाठरी में सपनां सांचो,
पधारो म्हारे देश में, मिट्टी में बांचो।
translated_poem:
In the bundle of Thar, dreams come true,  
Come to my land, live in the soil’s hue.

stanzas.loss_note: 'बांचो' (to read/absorb deeply) loses its sense of intimate communion with the soil beyond mere living.

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: the Thar desert as a bundled inheritance carrying the weight of dreams and ancestral memory
reading oneself into the soil as an act of belonging and identity-formation in the desert land

cultural_entities.translation_note: Thar retained but its connotation as a living cultural-spiritual landscape is flattened to a geographic bundle.
Traditional Rajasthani hospitality invocation partially preserved; its ceremonial warmth is somewhat diluted.
